notes: Copy and paste marks on the drawing: pick counts and pipe runs, Ctrl+C, then point the mouse anywhere on any drawing (in any window) and Ctrl+V pastes them there, in the same items, at their real size. Right-click Paste puts them where you right-clicked; Paste into New Items makes new items. Picked marks can be dragged from the main window into an undocked drawing window: they move there, or hold Ctrl as you let go to copy them.
